message.reasoning_content:
Round 5 market. If I hold cash via sell_credit, promissory added at start of round 6, then round 6... promissory added to cash at start of round 6 market, but after last round promissory unpaid? "After the last round the bill is not repaid" — round 6 market sell_credit would be unpaid. Round 5 promissory gets paid at start of round 6 (cash=floor/100*62, then promissory added). But cash dev of round 5 earnings at 62%? Wait round 6 start: cash=floor(cash/100)*62 — devaluation applies to existing cash, promissory added full. So sell_credit protects round-5 cash from devaluation, but promissory sold in round 6 won't be paid.

So best: sell all 6 credit now (12) — get 65 alashi promissory, added to cash next round. Meanwhile keep 8.57 cash which devalues to ~5.3. Then in round 6 sell nothing (no goods). Rank by cash+hard: 65+8.5 vs sell now 60.5, then devalue 62% → 37.5. Credit clearly better.

Actually could sell some now (spend?) no buys needed. Choice 12.
